scope: Seven compatible research directions jointly, plus original market-change features; not every parameter of every failed model
target: Actual retail margin minus frozen original expanding-window production prediction
training_regime: 2021 onward only; published earlier OOF residuals
missing_inputs: BLOCK; no zero fill, no future training, no changing feature subsets
diesel: Remove 2022Q2 through 2023Q2 features from both training and scoring due survey break
peer: Latest public overlapping fiscal period strictly before target quarter end; unexpected margins only
evaluation: All eligible matched quarters plus fixed six-big-miss coverage and error report; squared-error fitting without ex-post big-miss weighting; same-row simpler model and remove-best-benefit diagnostic
tail_claim: One scored big miss cannot establish systematic tail improvement
tuning: One model, no parameter grid or feature subset search
promotion: Research only; existing gate; never automatic
